title: Thak gayi hu chalte chalte
body:
Rone bhi nahi Deta taziyane marta Hai Mujhko Subah Shaam
Baba O Mere Baba
thak gayi Hoon Chalte Chalte Karbala se Sham
thak gayi Hoon Chalte Chalte Karbala se Sham
Rone....
Thak...
1) jakar najaf me Kehna Mere Dada jaan se
Zalim ne cheeni  baliyan hai mere Kaan se
Rone bhi nahi Deta taziyane marta Hai Mujhko Subah Shaam
2) chhale Pade hain Paon Mein chhal sakti
hai reit itni garm muh pe mal nahi Sakte
Tanha Hai Teri Dukhiya Dars dikha jao Mera Ghar huwa tabah
3) khaime jalaye jism se phir kaat Liya sar
Ek pal me todh Dala hai dekho nabi ka ghar
Baba wo mere Baba ... Bekason ke sar pe aa padi hai kaisi Shaam
4) Main dhoondthi hoon Raut pe Ek chota sa laSha
Godhi me usko leke khilati thi batasha
Haye Haye asghar e naadan... Che mah ka wo bezaban wo tashnakaam ..
5)bhaiya sajaad ka hai jala Aag me bisthar
Hai bojh sakht itni ki tedi huwi kamar
Humrah.. aayiye Baba ... Ja Rahi Ladli aseer hoke Shaam..
